summary: Iter 18 — Reviewed the new single-glance Admin Dashboard (backend GET /api/admin/dashboard + frontend /admin/dashboard). Backend: 3/3 existing contract tests + 3/3 new tests (non-admin rejection, deeper invariants, regression on 4 admin endpoints) all pass. Smoke suite still 9/9 green. Frontend: /admin redirects to /admin/dashboard, all 32 required data-testids present, tiles/attention rows/shortcuts/nav-dashboard/refresh all wired correctly, click-throughs land on /presence, /admin/approvals, /muster as designed. Zero console errors. No regression on /presence, /muster, /admin/members, /admin/reports, /admin/approvals.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/dashboard.py bulk-loads users with a 5000 cap, but if the org ever exceeds that, silent truncation would skew every metric. Consider raising the cap or paginating and asserting count(users) <= cap with a warning.

The `absent_athletes_today` computation counts only leave-covered exceptions (excused_leaves); athletes on approved tour/break may still show as 'absent'. Confirm intended semantics or extend the filter to cover tour/break types (routes/dashboard.py L84-98).

OT hours use `overtime_status == 'approved'` but the leave_days section filters by `type == 'leave'` (excludes tour/comp-off etc.) — this is a policy choice; document it in the endpoint docstring so future readers don't diverge.

Frontend Dashboard.jsx: auto-refresh every 60s calls `load(true)` but there's no cleanup / no in-flight guard — if a refresh takes >60s (slow network) two concurrent requests could race and toggle setData twice. Minor; not observed in preview.
Sparkline SVG has no aria-label / role='img' description — accessibility win to add tooltip on hover or aria label like `${lastAth} athletes today, ${lastStaff} staff/coaches today`.
